title: Chapter 586 - 586 Agreed; Worried!
content:
Chapter 586 - 586 Agreed; Worried!

Chapter 586 - 586 Agreed; Worried!

586 Agreed; Worried!

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s face flashed with surprise.

Hua Nation’s live broadcast room was in an uproar.

“Wow!” Xiao Bing exclaimed excitedly. “The Heavenly Hound is so powerful!”

Sigh: [This grizzly bear… It seemed to be the grizzly bear that was hunting down Li Xianhao from Corea, right? It was actually killed by the Heavenly Hound so easily!]

Repentant: [What a strong dog!]

Ruthless: [The Heavenly Hound can actually grow bigger. It’s so cool! It’s like a killing tool!]

A Little Sweet: [A killing tool? Do you think it can turn into a human? If he turns into a human, he’d definitely be very handsome!]

Old Man: [That’s awesome!]

…

After the Heavenly Hound killed the giant bear, it returned to its previous one-meter-tall body.

Lin Fan sized up the Heavenly Hound before turning his attention to the giant bear.

He touched his nose and said, “It seems that the ingredients for today are already available.”

The Heavenly Hound seemed to have understood something and quickly found many branches.

Lin Fan smiled. “Not bad!”

He waved his knife and peeled off the fur of the giant bear, cutting the meat into a few large pieces.

Yesterday, the Heavenly Hound had already seen Lin Fan’s steps in roasting meat.

It knew that it was time to start a fire.

Thus, the Heavenly Hound opened its mouth and spat out a wisp of flame, instantly igniting the branches.

Lin Fan smiled. “You’re sensible!”

As he spoke, he smeared seasonings on the meat while flipping it.

From time to time, he would make some requests.

“Make the fire bigger.

“Make it smaller.”

The Heavenly Hound hurriedly controlled the fire accordingly.

He could control the flame at any time. This made the roasted meat today even more fragrant than before.

The Heavenly Hound stared unblinkingly at the roasted meat. Its mouth was half-open, allowing its saliva to flow freely.

When the outer skin of the giant bear meat gradually suffused a golden color, Lin Fan picked up a piece of meat and placed it in his mouth.

“Mmm, it tastes good!” Lin Fan nodded his head in satisfaction.

Then, he picked up another piece of meat and placed it in front of the Heavenly Hound. “Try it too.”

The Heavenly Hound could not hold itself back any longer.

It eagerly opened its mouth and wolfed down the food. It ate happily and wagged its tail.

Lin Fan had only eaten a little bit when the Heavenly Hound had already finished his portion.

Hence, Lin Fan took out another piece of meat and said, “If you like it, then eat more.”

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Worried: [It’s time for the food broadcast again.]

Pro: [Fortunately, God Lin is eating a bear in another world. If he were in Hua Nation, he would have been investigaed by now.]

Green: [Investigated? Teacher Zhang San had said that if one is hungry in the wilderness, there’s no problem for one to eat pandas or tigers upon encountering them!]

Second Brother: [The Heavenly Hound can control flames. It’s like a gas stove. Now it seems that letting the Heavenly Hound use the Beginner Fire Control Technique doesn’t seem too bad.]

Enjoying Loneliness: [The relationship between the God Lin and the Heavenly Hound is getting better and better. Perhaps he can subdue it!]

Heartbreak: [Conquer the Heavenly Hound? In that case, it seems good to let the Heavenly Hound have more skills!]

…

Initially, most of the comments on Yuan Yuan’s Weibo post were in agreement with what she said.

However, not long after, the comments supporting Lin Fan increased again.

This made Yuan Yuan a little unhappy.

Hence, she posted another Weibo post.

Yuan Yuan: [Wild beasts are uncontrollable!

[We should remember that all beasts are uncontrollable.

[Even the tigers and lions in the zoo would sometimes attack the breeders, resulting in some casualties.

[Furthermore, Lin Fan has been feeding the Heavenly Hound.

[The Heavenly Hound is so strong and terrifying. If it attacks Lin Fan, that would be too terrifying!

[Lin Fan represents the future of Hua Nation!

[He shouldn’t be so careless!]

It had to be said that Yuan Yuan was indeed a writer. With just a few words, people agreed with her.

At the same time, many people started to worry for nothing. They even started to blame Lin Fan.

Yuan Yuan was very happy about this.

…

Soon, the entire bear was eaten clean.

Of course, Lin Fan only ate a small portion of it.

The rest were all eaten by the Heavenly Hound.

This was not because Lin Fan’s food had been snatched away by the Heavenly Hound.

The bear was simply too big. Even a small portion of it was enough for Lin Fan to eat his fill.

Lin Fan looked at the Heavenly Hound that was wagging its tail and reached out to stroke its head.

Generally speaking, a powerful beast like the Heavenly Hound would not let people get close to it easily, let alone let someone touch its head.

However, when Lin Fan touched the head of the Heavenly Hound, it did not dodge or get angry.

Instead, it stood on the spot with a look of enjoyment.

At this moment, an emotionless voice rang out in Lin Fan’s ears.

[You’re the first person to establish a friendship with a level-six Heavenly Hound. You’ve received a level-six treasure chest.]

[You’re the first person to establish a friendship with a level-six Heavenly Hound. The lifespan of Hua people will increase by ten years.]

At the same time, bright lights shot out from Hua Nation’s Void Gates.

Some of the old men who had fallen to the ground stood up very steadily.

Some people who had heart attacks suddenly recovered.

Some people who had been paralyzed by a stroke were suddenly able to walk upright.

…

Miracles appeared in every corner of Hua Nation.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing exclaimed, “Our lifespan has increased by ten years?”

The bullet comments were like rain, covering the entire live broadcast room.

Brother Qiang: [F*ck!]

Zhang: [F*ck!]

Almost Done: [F*ck!]

…

First, the entire screen was filled with exclamations.

After a while, other comments appeared.

Pure: [Thank you, God Lin, for letting me live another ten years!]

Abandoned: [Thank you, God Lin, for giving me ten extra years!]

Fantasy: Awesome! The Heavenly Hound is actually a level-six beast!]

Fei: [Demon King! This is a proper Demon King!]

Blue Vest: [No wonder the Heavenly Hound could kill the giant bear with one paw!]

Air: [God Lin has established a friendship with the Heavenly Hound. This is too awesome!]

Honor: [It seems that God Lin only gave the Heavenly Hound some food. Oh, he even gave it the Beginner Fire Control Technique, and he became friends with the Heavenly Hound. As expected, people should still adore pets.]

Flower in the Wind: [I thought it was a loss to give the Beginner Fire Control Technique to the Heavenly Hound, but now it seems that it’s not bad a choice!]

Man’s Heart: [A friendship with a level-six Heavenly Hound. Doesn’t that mean that God Lin can do whatever he wants in the other world in the future?]

Ku Ku: [There’s nothing wrong with that. God Lin can do whatever he wants!]

…

It was not easy for Yuan Yuan to make the public dissatisfied with Lin Fan and start to panic.

In the end, the situation changed again in the blink of an eye.

There were even some people who questioned her and asked why she was slandering Lin Fan.

The most important thing was that the lifespan of the Hua people had increased by ten years!

She was no longer a citizen of Hua Nation!

She could not enjoy this benefit!

This made Yuan Yuan even more unhappy.

Hence, Yuan Yuan posted on Weibo again.

Yuan Yuan: [Look back on history!

[History has taught us that friendships between two people are not reliable.

[This can also be said for humans and animals.

[I even think that the friendship between humans and animals is even weaker than that between humans.

[Lin Fan has temporarily established a friendship with the Heavenly Hound.

[The advantage is that it can light firewood.

[But in exchange, he lost a fire control skill?

[This isn’t worth it.

[In fact, in my opinion, let alone fire control skills, even meat shouldn’t be given to the Heavenly Hound.

[Because, at crucial times, meat is survival!

[Lin Fan is still too arrogant, immature, and irresponsible!

[I’m worried about the future.]
